a: Protect long focus blocks for deep work.
Cap research spikes so they do not expand forever.
If it takes under two minutes, do it now.
Batch Slack/email instead of continuous context switching.
Know what done means before starting a task.
Schedule hard tasks at your peak energy hours.
Schedule weekly learning like any other meeting.
End the day with a written next-action list.
Sleep and exercise outperform another late-night coding session.
